title: Photoshop Beginner Lesson 1: Workspace, Panels, and Basic File Management (PiXimperfect)
summary: PiXimperfect’s Photoshop for Complete Beginners: Start Here (Lesson 1) guides new users through core concepts and setup for Photoshop. It starts with what Photoshop does and explains pixels and megapixels, then covers installing or updating via Creative Cloud, and distinguishes the Home screen from the work space. The video demonstrates how to switch and customize workspaces, save a personal setup, and organize panels, followed by a practical hands-on project that introduces brushes, text, and layers. It then walks through saving practices (Save, Save As, PSD), exporting for web (JPEG/PNG), and essential navigation shortcuts, including transform controls, zoom/pan techniques, and the contextual taskbar that adapts to the active tool. The session culminates with quick tips on undo/redo, layout fundamentals (canvas/tools/panels), and a reminder of how to access any missing panels via the Window menu.
topics: Save vs Save As vs Save a Copy
Options bar, Status bar, Menu bar
Zoom and pan shortcuts (Spacebar, scrubby zoom, H key)
